children: Concentrix Chief Financial Officer Andre Valentine, who has been in that role since 2018, will step down Dec. 1 and remain with the company through May 31.
The company named Chinnu S. Varghese as its next CFO. She was previously senior vice president and group controller at Marelli.

Concentrix's operations include call centers and artificial intelligence-related services. In September, it announced the purchase of CastleHill Managed Risk Solutions, expanding its risk and compliance capabilities.
Revenue for the third quarter ended Aug. 31 declined 1.2% to $2.45 billion.
